name: noetloom
description: Portable instructions for autonomous software development by capable agents and humans, with optional discovery and helper conveniences.

interface.longDescription: Portable written instructions for autonomous software development. Any capable agent or human can read BOOTSTRAP.md and the operating model, derive project phases and guidance, then implement, verify, repair, integrate, and continue with ordinary project tools. The plugin adds optional native discovery and helper conveniences; Python 3.11 is needed only for optional helpers. The host must provide the ordinary tools required by the chosen application. Noetloom does not listen to other conversations, run in the background, or grant deployment permissions.
defaultPrompt: Build an offline reading list here. Derive phases and guidance, implement, test, repair, and finish the agreed boundary.
Continue the current objective: inspect the workspace, select ready work, implement, test, repair, and integrate.
Verify the objective against its acceptance boundary, fix gaps, and report the evidence and remaining blockers.
